findings.issue: IsLocallyBoundedOn is a Prop predicate whose body is not @[expose]d and has no `isLocallyBoundedOn_def`/iff restatement. A downstream consumer whose family is bounded on each compact K but not globally (the general case local boundedness is meant to capture) can neither construct nor destructure it in the defining compact-set form without unfolding an opaque def; `isLocallyBoundedOn_of_forall_norm_le` only handles a single global constant and `exists_forall_norm_le` only a single point.

summary: The estimate lemmas and exposure are well-scoped, but the new predicate IsLocallyBoundedOn lacks its characteristic *_def/iff restatement and its body is not exposed, so the general compact-set intro/elim is only reachable by unfolding an opaque def. The two supplied lemmas cover only special cases (global-constant intro, single-point elim).
